GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   D. Treat Climate as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

6. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

10. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

13. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.

16. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
